In Duval's algorithm for Lyndon factorization, what characterization of Lyndon words does the algorithm exploit?

C) A string w is Lyndon iff it is strictly greater than all its proper prefixes. Duval's algorithm repeatedly removes the smallest non-Lyndon suffix.
D) A string w is Lyndon iff it is lexicographically minimal among its conjugates. Duval's algorithm runs in O(n log n) using suffix arrays.
